question:
The lateral surface of a cone unfolds into a sector. Which of the following statements is correct?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_258_q2_question_en.svg)
solution: After unfolding, the sector's radius is the slant height \(l\), and its arc length is the circumference of the base circle, \(2\pi r\).
